Veil of Darkness Event Gehenna.
Do not replace as long as this card is in play. Each turn, when a
vampire plays his or her first card that turn that requires any
Disciplines, that vampire`s controller reveals the top card of his or
her library (before drawing to replace). If it is a master card, the
original card has no effect (no cost is paid), and in addition, if the
original card required Obtenebration [obt], the vampire burns 2
blood. R G

If I have an ally that is able to play cards "as a vampire", am I then
affected by VoD when said ally plays their first discipline-requiring
card in a turn?

I would say no.

Cheers,

-merto
